security.name: Lululemon Athletica Inc.
security.long_business_summary: lululemon athletica inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, distributes, and retails technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories for women and men under the lululemon brand in the United States, Canada, Mexico, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Macau, Greece, and internationally. It offers pants, shorts, tops, and jackets for athletic activities, such as yoga, running, training, and other activities. The company also provides fitness-inspired accessories. It sells its products through company-operated stores; seasonal stores, pop-ups, university campus retailers, and yoga and fitness studios; outlets; Like New, a re-commerce program; and its e-commerce website. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

items.name: Stable Margins

items.name: High Owner Earnings
items.reason: Owner earnings ≈ net income + D&A − maintenance capex, as a share of revenue — the cash an owner could extract.

items.name: Predictable Business
items.reason: How steady revenue and earnings have been — predictable businesses are easier to value and less cyclical.

items.name: Conservative Accounting
items.reason: Cash flow from operations relative to net income — earnings backed by cash (low accruals) indicate conservative accounting.

items.name: Attractive Valuation
items.reason: Valuation multiples and yields versus the market, the sector, and the company's own historical range — cheaper relative to quality scores higher.
